primitives.name: Offensive Line Personnel Prop Edge
primitives.verbatim_quote: OFFENSIVE LINE PERSONNEL & PROP EDGES ### Core Principle Starting QBs and the 5 starting offensive linemen play 100% of offensive snaps when healthy.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S_{OL}': 'snap share of starting OL (dimensionless)', 'P_{pkg}': 'personnel package type (11, 12, 13, etc.)'}
primitives.assumptions: Starting OL maintain 100% snap share under health; personnel packages affect defensive alignment and prop outcomes.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When S_{OL} < 95%, indicates injury or benching event.

layer2.mapping: Snap share variance in OL personnel packages correlates with defensive DVOA and receiver prop outcomes.
layer2.telemetry: OL injury substitution events and QB hurry rate changes.

primitives.name: Running Back Timeshare Dynamics
primitives.verbatim_quote: True bell cows (>300 half-PPR points): McCaffrey (2x), Barkley, Robinson, Taylor, Jacobs.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'C_{RB}': 'carries per RB (dimensionless)', 'S_{RB}': 'snap share of RB (percentage)', 'P_{PPR}': 'half-PPR points per game (points)'}
primitives.assumptions: Bell cows exceed 300 half-PPR points; timeshare splits reflect role clarity and performance consistency.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When C_{RB} < 150 or S_{RB} < 30%, indicates diminished role or injury.

layer2.mapping: Timeshare regimes map to Markov transition matrices for RB role stability.
layer2.telemetry: RB carry distribution and snap share shifts over 4-week windows.

primitives.name: Tight End Archetype Classification
primitives.verbatim_quote: TE who only plays 11-personnel is volume-dependent; TE who only plays 12-personnel is efficiency-dependent but lower floor ###
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'R_{TE}': 'route percentage per snap (percentage)', 'T_{TE}': 'target rate per route (dimensionless)', 'P_{pkg}': 'personnel package (11, 12, etc.)'}
primitives.assumptions: Route ratio determines TE archetype; 11-personnel favors volume, 12-personnel favors efficiency.
primitives.breakdown_regime: R_{TE} < 40% indicates blocking TE; R_{TE} > 60% indicates pass-catching TE.

layer2.mapping: TE archetype classification maps to target share variance in slot receiver models.
layer2.telemetry: TE target rate and route share in 11/12 personnel contexts.
